description: This file provides a stub implementation of a Supabase client, intended to replace live network interactions with placeholder responses indicating that Supabase has been removed from the backend. It defines classes and functions related to a minimal, non-functional Supabase client, serving as a compatibility layer for existing code that depends on Supabase, while explicitly disabling actual interactions.

classes.name: _StubResponse
classes.description: A minimal HTTP-like response object mimicking responses from the httpx library, used to simulate network responses with status codes and payloads.

classes.name: SupabaseClient
classes.description: A stubbed Supabase client class that provides the same interface as the real client, but all methods return 501 Not Implemented responses to indicate that Supabase functionality has been removed.

methods.name: "SupabaseClient" anon_mode(cls)
methods.description: Creates a stub client in anonymous mode.

methods.name: "SupabaseClient" user_mode(cls, token: Optional[str])
methods.description: Creates a stub client using a user's bearer token.

methods.name: "SupabaseClient" admin_mode(cls)
methods.description: Creates a stub client with administrative privileges.

methods.name: get(self, table: str, params: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None)
methods.description: Stub method to mimic an HTTP GET request; returns a 501 response indicating disabled Supabase REST.

methods.name: post(self, table: str, json: Optional[Any] = None)
methods.description: Stub method to mimic an HTTP POST request; returns a 501 response.

methods.name: upsert(self, table: str, json: Optional[Any] = None)
methods.description: Stub method to mimic an UPSERT operation; returns a 501 response.

methods.name: close(self)
methods.description: No-op method for closing the client, matching the expected async interface.

methods.name: None get_supabase()
methods.description: Function that returns None, indicating Supabase has been removed.

methods.name: Optional[str] parse_bearer(token: Optional[str])
methods.description: Extracts the token from a 'Bearer <token>' authorization header string.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] decode_supabase_jwt(token: Optional[str])
methods.description: Returns an empty payload dictionary; JWT handling via Supabase is not used.

methods.name: __init__(self, status_code: int = 501, payload: Optional[Union[dict, list, str]] = None)

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, mode: str = "anon", token: Optional[str] = None):$/

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, status_code: int = 501, payload: Optional[Union[dict, list, str]] = None)/
ctags.signature: (self, status_code: int = 501, payload: Optional[Union[dict, list, str]] = None)

ctags.name: get
ctags.pattern: /^    async def get(self, table: str, params: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None):$/
ctags.signature: (self, table: str, params: Optional[Mapping[str, str]] = None)

ctags.name: post
ctags.pattern: /^    async def post(self, table: str, json: Optional[Any] = None):$/

ctags.name: upsert
ctags.pattern: /^    async def upsert(self, table: str, json: Optional[Any] = None):$/
